# Tapir

> Tapir is a free, open-source (MIT) add-on for Graphisoft Archicad 25–30, by
> ENZYME-APD and its community. It adds 789 JSON commands to Archicad's own JSON API, a palette
> that runs Python scripts in one click and a Grasshopper plugin (package `tapir` on the Rhino Package
> Manager); community MCP servers let AI assistants drive Archicad through it. A new release ships
> every Monday.

- Site: https://archicad-api.com/
- Source, issues and releases: https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation
- Download (Tapir Installer for Windows and macOS): https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/releases/latest
- Community (Discord): https://discord.gg/NAnSennmpY
- Tapir started in 2022 as R&D at Enzyme, an architecture practice; the add-on is built on Tibor
  Lorántfy's archicad-additional-json-commands template.

## How a Tapir command is sent

Archicad (with a project open) answers JSON on `http://127.0.0.1:19723`. Tapir's commands go
through Archicad's own `API.ExecuteAddOnCommand`, in the namespace `TapirCommand`:

```json
{"command": "API.ExecuteAddOnCommand",
 "parameters": {"addOnCommandId": {"commandNamespace": "TapirCommand", "commandName": "GetAddOnVersion"},
                "addOnCommandParameters": {}}}
```

The answer is `{"succeeded": true, "result": {"addOnCommandResponse": {...}}}`. Python's standard
library is enough (`urllib.request`); the official `archicad` package and the Tapir Grasshopper
plugin send the same JSON. Every command, with its parameters and an example, is in
[commands.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands.md) and [commands.json](https://archicad-api.com/commands.json).

## Docs

- [Tapir – free Archicad automation: Python, JSON API, Grasshopper](https://archicad-api.com/index.md): Tapir is a free, open-source Archicad add-on: hundreds of extra JSON commands, a palette that runs scripts in one click, and a Grasshopper plugin.
- [Automate Archicad with Python – get started | Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/start/index.md): Install Tapir, run a script from the Tapir palette in Archicad, add more scripts, write a first Python script and install the Grasshopper plugin.
- [Archicad automation docs | Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/docs/index.md): Tapir's documentation: every JSON command, the Grasshopper guide, the Archicad API coverage and the Grasshopper coverage, and how a call to Tapir works.
- [Free Archicad Python scripts | Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/scripts/index.md): Free Python scripts for the Tapir palette in Archicad, shared by architects, each one reviewed and adapted to work in any office before it is listed.
- [Share an Archicad script | Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/scripts/share/index.md): Share an Archicad script you wrote: send it on Discord or as a pull request, and it is checked, adapted to work in any office and listed with your name.
- [Archicad Grasshopper live connection | Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/grasshopper/index.md): Connect Grasshopper live to a running Archicad with the Tapir plugin: read, change and create Archicad elements from Rhino geometry, without writing code.
- [Control Archicad with AI assistants (MCP) | Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/ai/index.md): Control Archicad with Claude and other AI assistants through Tapir: the Tapir MCP servers, a prompt to start with, and how to let an AI write a script.
- [Archicad automation tutorials | Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/tutorials/index.md): Videos that show Tapir at work in Archicad and Grasshopper: installing it, selecting elements, columns, Grasshopper, spreadsheet sync and filtering.
- [What the Archicad API can't do | Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/limits/index.md): What people ask for that Graphisoft's Archicad API does not offer, such as undo or the clipboard, each with what to do instead and the DevKit evidence.
- [Batch rename views in Archicad | Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/tutorials/batch-rename-views/index.md): Rename the views of the Archicad View Map in one go with a Tapir script: find and replace, a prefix and a suffix, or a pattern with a counter, checked first.
- [Connect Grasshopper to Archicad | Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/tutorials/connect-grasshopper-to-archicad/index.md): Install the Tapir Add-On and the tapir package for Rhino, then build a first Grasshopper definition that reads an Archicad wall and changes its height.
- [Export Archicad element properties to Excel with Python | Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/tutorials/export-properties-to-excel/index.md): Write the property values of Archicad elements into an Excel or CSV file, one row per element, with a Tapir script; edit them in Excel and read them back.
- [Your first Archicad Python script | Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/tutorials/first-python-script/index.md): Install Tapir, write a short Python script that calls one Tapir command through aclib, and run it from the Tapir palette in Archicad, no packages needed.
- [Number doors and windows by room in Archicad | Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/tutorials/number-doors-and-windows-by-zone/index.md): Give every Archicad door and window an Element ID from the zone it opens into, such as 1.04-D1, numbered within each zone, with a Tapir script.

## Project

- [Community – Archicad automation with Tapir](https://archicad-api.com/community/index.md): Ask on Discord, report a bug, test a fix in your Archicad: how Tapir's community and its bots turn a report into a release, and how the project grew.
- [Tapir roadmap – Archicad automation](https://archicad-api.com/roadmap/index.md): How to ask for a feature in Tapir, the Archicad add-on, what people are asking for now, what shipped from the old list and which ideas are still open.
- [About Tapir – open-source Archicad add-on](https://archicad-api.com/about/index.md): Why the open-source Archicad add-on Tapir exists, how it grew from Enzyme's R&D and Tibor Lorántfy's JSON template, who builds it and how to support it.

## Reference

- [Commands as JSON](https://archicad-api.com/commands.json): the same, with the full JSON schemas and the example code.
- [archicad-addon](https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/): The command reference, also as commands.md and commands.json.
- [api-coverage](https://archicad-api.com/api-coverage/): Which parts of the Archicad API Tapir uses, updated hourly; data: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/api-coverage/api-coverage.md
- [gh-coverage](https://archicad-api.com/gh-coverage/): Which Tapir commands have a Grasshopper component; data: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/api-coverage/gh-coverage.md
